HTTP/2 (test page)
5. Streams
A stream is a sequence of frames that both peers send on one connection.
5.1. Stream States
open:
Both peers may send any frame on an open stream.
Either peer may set the END_STREAM flag on a frame, and the stream then moves
to one of the two half-closed states.
closed:
Closed is the last state of a stream.
6.4. RST_STREAM
A peer sends RST_STREAM to end a stream at once.
